item_name: Smith & Wesson Assisted Opening Military & Police Knife
item_short_desc: The Smith & Wesson Assisted Opening Military & Police Knife features a side safety M.A.G.I.C. assisted opening system that allows single-handed operation. Designed for military and law enforcement use, it's durable in the extreme, with an aluminum handle with rubber inserts and a titanium-coated stainless steel, half-serrated blade.
